name: Ookami-san no Ongaeshi?
original_name: おおかみさんのおんがえし？
source:
On a full moon night girl gives a healing to a weak wolf. But after some time grateful wolf returns...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一個滿月之夜，女孩為一隻虛弱的狼施展治療術。但過了一段時間，感恩的狼回來了……
